title: Adapting Large Language Models for Content Moderation: Pitfalls in Data Engineering and Supervised Fine-tuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on fine-tuning LLMs for content moderation, which involves evaluating and benchmarking the model's ability to identify and reason about unethical or harmful content, such as discrimination, violence, and pornography. The inclusion of a 'reasoning process' (Chain-of-Thought) to justify classification results specifically evaluates the model's ability to identify unethical behavior.
